test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of question mark(?) in the following equation?

6.05 - 15.95 ÷ 3.95 + 2.99 × 7.04 = ?
solution:
**Given:**

6.05 - 15.95 ÷ 3.95 + 2.99 × 7.04 = ?

**Calculation:**

According to the question

The closest approximate value is

⇒ 6 – 16 ÷ 4 + 3 × 7

⇒ 6 – 4 + 3 × 7

⇒ 6 – 4 + 21

⇒ 27 – 4

⇒ 23

**∴ The required value of ? is 23**
